---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability, with the situation that calls for it
labels: enhancement
---

## The situation

What are you trying to do, and what makes it awkward today? Concrete beats abstract — the
policy surface is deliberately small, so a real scenario is what justifies growing it.

## What you have tried

Workarounds, and where they fall short.

## What you would want

If it belongs in `TaskPolicy`, say which layer should set it (decorator, project config,
or runtime) and what should happen when two layers disagree.

## Scope check

Some things are deliberately out of scope — see the list in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md). If your request is one of them, make the case for
why this situation is different.
